default/31387.htm.text: Kurstin: What brings you to this accursed village? All you'll find here are despair, gloom and helplessness! It's a trap, a maze whose exit is forever sealed! No one get in... or out! Although we see each other now, we are in two very different places. Looks can be very deceiving!

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-01.html.text: Kurstin: Why have you come to me? This is a dangerous place. You'd best hide yourself before nightfall...

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-04.html.text: Kurstin: This jewel is called the Bloody Jewel. The magical essence of an ancient Vampire has been condensed in it, making it extremely powerful. The Vampire belonged to an order of magicians and intended to use the jewel's power to help him evolve into a new creature.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-11.html.text: Kurstin: Would you like to see the note again?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-02.html.text: Kurstin: Gasp! That's... a Blood Jewel!? Did the Katenar send you?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-03.html.text: Kurstin: I see. Well then, give me that jewel and I'll explain everything. Hmm, where should I start?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-05a.html.text: Kurstin: It's because my other master wants it. Come to think of it, he wants quite a few items these days. I wonder if he has something special in the works... Ah, but that's none of your concern, is it? Do you have any other questions? Perhaps something more important?

links.text: Ask why he doesn't do it himself.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-05b.html.text: Kurstin: He said that he needs it to preserve the power of this forest. That is all I know. I am not privy to his plans. I only know this because a friend of mine told me what our lord told him...

links.text: Ask why he doesn't do it himself.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-06.html.text: Kurstin: To tell you the truth, I don't know. He said that the contract doesn't allow him to do it... He said that he would send someone else to do it, and told me to answer him. I wondered if he needed to be in hiding, but I didn't find any relationship between that and acquiring the Bloody Jewel.

links.text: Ask if he left a message.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-07.html.text: Kurstin: Yes, I have it. Ah...the note...yes, here it is. Will you read it?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-08.html.text: Kurstin: I cannot tell you more about the happenings within this forest because it is under the influence of one of the beings that created the Kamael... We were created by someone, after all. Among our kind, the Harkilgamed, Rodenpicula, Hierarch Kekropus and I are unique. That is why you will not…

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/31387-10.html.text: Kurstin: You can hear more details from Harkilgamed. He is hiding in the Valley of the Saints . Go see him and ask about Spicula .
